name: Valle de Uco
keyfacts: Luján de Cuyo and the Uco Valley make most of Mendoza's top wines, with Uco sites such as Altamira, Gualtallary, San Pablo and Vista Flores highly regarded.
Tupungato, in the Uco Valley, has more Chardonnay than any other Mendoza department, about a quarter of the province's total.
Low rainfall and the low humidity that comes with altitude limit vine disease.

notes: Uco Valley wines are deep in color, intense in aroma and rich in flavor.

blurb.text: A wine area in Mendoza, Argentina's leading wine province, with San Carlos, Tupungato and Tunuyán inside. Malbec dominates plantings at 55%, followed by Cabernet Sauvignon (10%) and Chardonnay (7%).
